question: What were the national ASF outbreaks, pigs culled and recombinant share by region in 2026 to date, and how many ASF vaccine doses were used in 2025 and 2026 by farm type?
why_it_matters: Sets whether the 2025 vaccine-escape finding is turning into larger waves (WC-03) and whether Decision 779 targets are on track; 2026 totals exist only in search snippets
cheapest_way_to_close: Written request to the Epidemiology Division; read its official letters (CNTY-DT series) and monthly bulletins on the department website
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health (Cuc Chan nuoi va Thu y)

question: Is any ASF vaccine with genotype I/II (recombinant) protection in field trials or licensing in Vietnam, and on what timeline?
why_it_matters: A cross-protective vaccine (WC-04) would ease ASF as a production risk and weaken the disease leg of the security case
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask AVAC, NAVETCO and Dabaco; check MAE veterinary vaccine licensing lists
owner_org_to_ask: AVAC Vietnam; NAVETCO; Dabaco; MAE Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health

question: What are the quantified targets in Decision 779/QD-TTg (2026 to 2030 plan) for vaccination coverage and disease-free facilities, and does the MAE veterinary AMR action plan 2024 to 2030 set a numeric target for antimicrobial use in animals?
why_it_matters: The study says it found no 2030 target for animal antimicrobial use (F2.2.3); the primary texts were blocked
cheapest_way_to_close: Read both decisions on vanban.chinhphu.vn or thuvienphapluat.vn from an unblocked connection

question: Did retail sales of tofu, soy milk and chay products rise during the ASF waves of 2019 and mid-2025 beyond a few weeks of panic?
why_it_matters: Tests whether plant protein ever bridges an animal-disease shock in Vietnam; current revealed evidence (annual tofu use flat) says no, press anecdotes say briefly yes
cheapest_way_to_close: Monthly retail scan data for 2018 to 2020 and 2024 to 2025, or category sales from two retailers
owner_org_to_ask: NielsenIQ or Kantar Vietnam; WinMart; Bach Hoa Xanh

question: How many human Streptococcus suis cases and deaths were recorded in 2025 by province, and why do provincial reports appear to exceed the national death count?
why_it_matters: The national MOH figure (2 deaths) and press reports from Hue and Hung Yen may disagree; the burden figure for the food-safety argument depends on it
cheapest_way_to_close: Request the 2025 notifiable disease summary; check NIHE and Pasteur Institute reports
owner_org_to_ask: MOH Department of Disease Prevention; National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology

question: Is there a Vietnam-specific estimate of the disease burden (DALYs) of pork-borne and poultry-borne foodborne disease?
why_it_matters: Would let the study size the food-safety cost of animal protein instead of citing prevalence studies
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask ILRI Hanoi and Hanoi University of Public Health (SafePORK team) for unpublished estimates
owner_org_to_ask: ILRI Hanoi; Hanoi University of Public Health
